tradeProofs.title: Receipts in P2P
tradeProofs.body: Attach a photo or a PDF of the payment to your trade, without going through the chat. Only the other party and support can see it.

lightningAddress.title: Your Lightning Address
lightningAddress.body: Receive sats from any Lightning wallet in the world at an address as simple as yourname@qvpay.me. They land in your balance instantly.

receiveAnywhere.title: Share it like an email
receiveAnywhere.body: Copy it, share it or show the QR from Receive. Phoenix, Wallet of Satoshi, Blink, Alby… anyone can pay you, no QvaPay account needed.

satsOrUsd.title: In USD or in sats, you choose
satsOrUsd.body: Dollars at the current price, or sats as they come with no fee, to spend in the store or withdraw over Lightning.

viaP2P.title: ETECSA balance and Cuban cards, via P2P
viaP2P.body: In Deposit, ETECSA balance and CUP/MLC cards are no longer left out: pick the coin and you'll see the best open offers to sell it and get the amount in your account.

ssnDeposit.title: Card and PayPal for US persons
ssnDeposit.body: If you're a US person with GOLD, verify your SSN in Personal details and deposit by card or PayPal up to $500 every 30 days.
